   - If rejected from w (unlikely due to my high priority), proposing to x next is reasonable because it is my second preference and I have a decent priority there.
   - If rejected from x, my next proposal would be to y, where I have the highest priority, although competition may be high.
   - Finally, z is my least preferred option and should be the last choice.

Thus, my strategy aligns with my preferences and optimizes my chances of being matched to a school where I have a high priority.
